name: Crucible Industries Talon-5 'Jackknife'
description:
The Crucible Industries Talon-5 is a slim single-stack semi-automatic pistol chambered in 5.7x28mm, designed around the high-velocity PDW cartridge for maximum penetration in a handgun platform. The weapon is unusually flat — barely two centimeters wide — with a flush-fit magazine and low-profile sights optimized for pocket and waistband carry.

The 5.7x28mm round was originally designed for personal defense weapons and gives the Talon-5 a unique advantage: the high-velocity, small-caliber projectile penetrates soft body armor that stops conventional pistol rounds. This makes the Jackknife a favorite among operators who expect their targets to be wearing protection. The trade-off is reduced terminal energy against unarmored tissue compared to larger calibers.

Crucible positions the Talon-5 as a 'threat-adapted concealment weapon' — a polite way of describing a gun designed to kill people wearing armor. The weapon's slim profile makes it genuinely easy to conceal, and its armor-defeating capability makes it genuinely dangerous. This combination has made it a subject of ongoing regulatory debate, with Shelf and Mid district security advocating for reclassification as a restricted weapon.
legality: Legal — under regulatory review for potential restriction
specifications:
caliber: 5.7x28mm
effective_range: 50 meters
rate_of_fire: Semi-automatic
magazine_capacity: 20 rounds
weight: 0.58 kg
tactical_use: A concealable pistol optimized for armor penetration. The 5.7x28mm round defeats Level II and IIIA soft body armor at close range, making this weapon effective against protected targets that conventional pistol calibers cannot address. The slim profile enables deep concealment. Less effective against unarmored targets than larger caliber alternatives due to reduced terminal energy.
cultural_context: The Jackknife is controversial. Shelf security forces hate it because it renders their standard-issue body armor ineffective. Crucible Industries defends it as a legitimate self-defense tool for citizens facing armored threats. The debate has become a proxy for larger arguments about the arms race between personal protection and personal armament in GLMZ.
story_hooks: A new regulation banning 5.7x28mm handguns is about to pass — and someone is buying every Talon-5 they can find before the ban takes effect. The question is why they need hundreds of armor-piercing pistols.
A Shelf security guard is killed by a Talon-5 round that penetrated his vest. The weapon is traced to a registered owner in the Spires who claims it was stolen — three months ago, unreported.

physical_description.visual_profile: A razor-thin, almost skeletal pistol that reads as aggressive minimalism — all business, no waste. The profile is unnaturally flat, like a playing card stood on edge. The slide runs the full length of the frame with minimal overhang. Low-mounted controls and sights refuse to break the weapon's sleek geometry.
physical_description.dimensions: Length: 17.8 cm | Width: 1.9 cm | Height: 12.1 cm | Barrel length: 10.2 cm
physical_description.weight_description: Surprisingly light and perfectly balanced — sits in the palm like it weighs nothing, yet carries substantial recoil authority. The slim profile makes it feel delicate until you fire it.
physical_description.primary_material: Hardened steel slide over aluminum-polymer lower receiver frame — weight distribution optimized for single-hand carry
physical_description.finish: Matte gunmetal gray slide with DLC (diamond-like carbon) coating; polymer frame in tactical black with subtle brushed aluminum accents around grip and trigger guard
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray and matte black with stainless steel magazine catch and trigger; minimal accent lighting in amber/gold around the sighting system
physical_description.grip_texture: Textured polymer with stippled grip surface for sweat/augmentation compatibility; ergonomic finger grooves worn smooth from heavy use in field conditions
distinctive_features: Ultra-thin profile — less than 2cm wide, designed for pocket carry without printing
Low-profile tritium night sights integrated flush into slide
Recessed grip safety under thumb ledge
Minimal controls: slide stop, mag release only
Small Φ-stamped rune on grip indicating pricing tier
5.7x28mm chamber stamp on barrel (visible through ejection port)
Heat stress marks on slide from high-velocity round signature
Custom stippling pattern resembling circuit traces
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Crucible Industries logo (geometric C intersecting with I) stamped subtly on left slide; 'TALON-5 JACKKNIFE' engraved along right slide in stark sans-serif; serial number on lower frame; small 'TIER 3+' compliance marking on grip
physical_description.condition_typical: Field-maintained, lightly worn; slide shows micro-scratches from holster friction and polymer frame exhibits faint wear marks from extended pocket carry. Well-lubricated, professionally maintained but clearly used
